description.text: An expansion pack of the Pokémon Card Game series, released on 27 January 2006, after early sales from 15 January at Pokémon Centers and the Next Generation World Hobby Fair. It is set at a lake further into Holon than the Holon Research Tower, and every Pokémon in it is either a δ Delta Species or one of Holon's Pokémon. Its packs hold ten cards, two of them holo, it reprints Rare Candy, and its Star card is a Delta Species Gyarados. The cards are numbered to 52. In English it became EX Holon Phantoms in May 2006.
